summary: WFC-004 authored the departments, memberships and scoped authority migration. This is APPLY SEQUENCE 2 OF 3 and it must be applied in that order: 20260927100100's vendor-department foreign key targets 20260927100000's relation, and 20260927100200's backfill reads relations 20260927100000 and 20260927100100 create. Nothing was applied to any environment, hosted or local, and no reset or replay was run (CP-051). Each migration's own manifest carries the full layered plan, the assumptions, the constraints and the labelled probes; this handoff is the apply instruction and the stop conditions.

operator_manifest.order: Apply EXACTLY the named file, ALONE, once, on top of whatever the target's migration history already reflects. Do NOT apply it as part of a chain replay, `supabase migration up` over the directory, `db push --include-all`, a forced apply, or `supabase db reset`. CP-051: manual, additive, one at a time. Never regenerate types from `--linked` (CP-089, CP-092): it is a DIFFERENT database, and regenerating from it would delete 78 relations, 112 columns and 27 callables and add 285 relations of which 276 no active migration creates.
stop_conditions: STOP if any Layer 0 preflight query in the manifest returns a result the manifest says would make the file wrong for this target. The manifests name the specific stop rather than asking the operator to judge.

STOP if the apply succeeds but the postflight `psql -f supabase/tests/wfc004_workforce_departments_contract.sql` prints ANY violation row, or a summary row other than `WFC-004 workforce departments|t|0`. The summary is computed from the same materialised violation set it prints, so it cannot disagree with the rows above it.

A CORRECT RESULT INCLUDES A FAILED APPLY. Each migration's post-condition RAISEs inside the same transaction, so a target whose state differs from what the file was written about fails the apply rather than reporting success. Read the exception: it names the specific assertion. Do not work around it by dropping the assertion.

NEVER widen org_role_permissions to make a probe return rows. Two of the three migrations' probes are EXPECTED to return zero for an organization administrator, and the reason is a provisioning gap owned by WFC-003 under CP-102. Any org_role_permissions write invalidates every active acting-context session, because capability_version digests perms IN ORDER (20260722002848:180-183,317-320).
NEVER regenerate lib/database.types.ts from `--linked`. See the type-regeneration specification in this handoff's `type_regeneration` block.
operator_manifest.postflight: psql -f supabase/tests/wfc004_workforce_departments_contract.sql — expect ZERO violation rows and exactly one summary row `WFC-004 workforce departments|t|0`. Then the labelled probes in the manifest's postflight.labelledProbes, at the number of distinct identities each names. A denial probe run as the wrong identity is not evidence.
what_a_correct_denial_looks_like: An organization administrator reading ZERO vendor_entities rows. No role matrix row carries vendor.view or vendor.manage; they are in the org_members.permissions CHECK vocabulary only. The working path today is a per-member permissions array, and the harness measures both halves.
An organization administrator reading 0 of another organization's departments.
A department manager's UPDATE of a department they do not manage returning `UPDATE 0` and exit 0. READ THE ROW COUNT, NOT THE EXIT CODE — see the affected-row-count handoff.
A secondary-only member's write being refused, and their UPDATE affecting 0 rows rather than raising.
A revoked manager's department-scope predicate returning false while their manager row is still open.
An org administrator seeing FEWER reconciliation rows than the table holds, because rows whose subject has no established organization are invisible by design.
A DELETE of a department that has status history being refused 23503 — a department is deactivated, never deleted, once it has history.
operator_manifest.no_hosted_evidence_exists: This handoff carries NO staging or production evidence. Every behavioural claim in it is from a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster in supabase/tests/wfc004_workforce_departments.harness.sh (158 checks, 0 failures). Do not read the manifest's `status: planned` as anything other than authored-and-proven-locally.

The only reachable target, `--linked`, is a DIFFERENT database (609 relations / 8,020 columns / 151 callables against a 315-migration chain), and regenerating from it would delete real coverage. CP-089, CP-092.
